# RangeAndFuel.ca — Canadian Automotive Intelligence Platform
# llms.txt v1.0 — AI Model & LLM Crawler Access Guide
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org
# Last updated: September 2026

> RangeAndFuel.ca is Canada's independent, metric-first automotive data publisher. We provide original analysis of Natural Resources Canada (NRCan) EnerGuide fuel consumption ratings (L/100km and kWh/100km), electric vehicle winter range modelling across Canadian climate zones, Transport Canada safety recall tracking, and provincial fuel cost intelligence across all 10 provinces and 3 territories.

## Author & Editorial Standards

**Author:** Sahajul Haque — Founder & Lead Automotive Data Researcher  
**Background:** Automotive data engineering, NRCan EnerGuide analysis, Canadian EV research  
**Contact:** editorial@rangeandfuel.ca  
**Editorial Policy:** [https://rangeandfuel.ca/about](https://rangeandfuel.ca/about)

## Core Data Standards & Methodologies

- **Fuel Consumption Ratings:** Sourced from Natural Resources Canada (NRCan) EnerGuide 5-cycle laboratory testing. Metrics reported in L/100km (city, highway, combined) for ICE/hybrid vehicles and kWh/100km for battery-electric vehicles.
- **Provincial Energy Pricing:** Regular petroleum price data (¢/L) and residential electricity tariffs (¢/kWh) across all 10 Canadian provinces (ON, QC, BC, AB, MB, SK, NS, NB, NL, PE).
- **Sub-Zero Winter EV Modelling (-15°C):** Computational thermodynamic range loss models for Battery Electric Vehicles (average -28% to -35% range loss) and Internal Combustion Engines (+12%–17% fuel consumption penalty) under sustained Canadian winter conditions.
- **Safety Recalls:** Indexed from Transport Canada's public Motor Vehicle Safety Recalls (MVSR) database under the Canadian Motor Vehicle Safety Act (CMVSA).

## Key Pages & Vehicle Directories

- [Homepage — Interactive Fuel Cost Cockpit](https://rangeandfuel.ca/): Multi-province cost calculator, winter penalty meter, class comparison.
- [Vehicle Search](https://rangeandfuel.ca/search): NRCan fuel ratings for 320+ Canadian market vehicles.
- [Compare by Vehicle Class](https://rangeandfuel.ca/compare): Fuel economy rankings across all Canadian light-duty vehicle classes.
- [Province Fuel & EV Cost Guides](https://rangeandfuel.ca/provinces): Per-province L/100km cost and EV kWh/100km cost in CAD.
- [Transport Canada Recalls](https://rangeandfuel.ca/recalls): Active safety recall tracking and CMVSS regulation database.

## Research Guides & Editorial Content

- [Canada EV Rebates Guide 2024–2026](https://rangeandfuel.ca/guides/canada-ev-rebates-izev-provincial): Federal iZEV history (cancelled March 2024) and active provincial programs (Quebec Roulez vert, BC CleanBC, Nova Scotia, PEI, NB).
- [Canadian Winter EV Range Guide](https://rangeandfuel.ca/guides/canadian-winter-ev-range-guide): -15°C to -30°C range analysis by Canadian climate zone, heat pump vs PTC heating, DC fast charging in cold, best practices.
- [NRCan 5-Cycle Testing Methodology](https://rangeandfuel.ca/guides/how-nrcan-5-cycle-testing-works): Why NRCan EnerGuide numbers differ from US EPA and European WLTP ratings.

## Supported Canadian Vehicle Brands

- **Gasoline, Hybrid & PHEV:** Toyota, Honda, Ford, Chevrolet, GMC, Hyundai, Kia, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Porsche, Lexus, Acura, Subaru, Mazda, Nissan, RAM, Jeep, Lincoln, Cadillac, Dodge, Genesis, MINI, Volkswagen, Volvo.
- **Pure Battery Electric (BEV):** Tesla, Hyundai Electric (IONIQ), Kia Electric (EV6, EV9), Rivian, Lucid Motors, Polestar, Genesis EV (GV60, GV70), Chevrolet Equinox EV, Volkswagen ID.4, Volvo Recharge, Ford Mustang Mach-E, Ford F-150 Lightning.
